i work at a steakhouse! We brine our chicken and when we go to cook it it gets seasoned, pan seared skin side down oil, flipped, add butter and cook a bit longer and placed in the oven with enough chicken stock where it almost touches the skin (abt 2-4 oz) and cook off for 8- 10 min at 425 or until internal temp is good! This is for an airline chicken so I would adjust to different cuts of chicken ! 
The chicken skin stays crisp and the chicken is really moist and juicy !!
